Store and/or access information on a device
Cookies, device or similar online identifiers (e.g. login-based identifiers, randomly assigned identifiers, network based identifiers) together with other information (e.g. browser type and information, language, screen size, supported technologies etc.) can be stored or read on your device to recognise it each time it connects to an app or to a website, for one or several of the purposes presented here.
Precise geolocation data, and identification through device scanning

Personalised advertising and content, advertising and content measurement, audience research and services development
Advertising and content can be personalised based on your profile. Your activity on this service can be used to build or improve a profile about you for personalised advertising and content. Advertising and content performance can be measured. Reports can be generated based on your activity and those of others. Your activity on this service can help develop and improve products and services.

Shannon Airport shortlisted for top marketing award for Best Place to Fly From campaign

  • Páraic McMahon
  • September 29, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:38
Instaread

Pictured at the launch of Shannon Airport’s “The Best Place To Fly From” campaign in February are brothers Fionn, Darragh and Oisin O’Connell from Newmarket On Fergus. Photograph: Arthur Ellis. 

A BRAND campaign from Shannon Airport has been shortlisted for a national marketing award.

Shannon Airport’s campaign ‘The Best Place to Fly From’ is nominated in the “Best in Class – Brand” category at the Digital Media Awards 2026.

Fronted by two feathered ‘frequent fliers’, Robin and Wren, the campaign is a fun, semi-animated celebration of the airport’s famously friendly and hassle‑free passenger experience.

It also taps into Shannon’s established reputation as Ireland’s Favourite Airport, earned through its award‑winning customer experience and status as Ireland’s top airport brand for three consecutive years (RED C BRII 2023-2025).

Developed in collaboration with media agency, Havas Media Ireland, and creative agency, Connelly Partners, the campaign has run nationwide across television, cinema, radio, digital and out‑of‑home channels throughout the year.

Organisations that demonstrate a clear and innovative strategy executed effectively across multiple channels and platforms are included in the ‘Best in Class’ category. Also nominated in this category are An Post, Chadwicks, Dublin Airport, ALLDAYS, Digital Irish, GoCar, Kooba and Leggit.

Commenting on the nomination, Vanessa McTigue, Commercial Director of The Shannon Airport Group, said: “It’s fantastic to see our ‘Best Place to Fly From’ campaign shortlisted at the prestigious Digital Media Awards, and we’re honoured to be recognised alongside some incredible brands and agencies.

“Our marketing team worked closely with our agency partner Havas Media Ireland, and brought our ‘frequent fliers’, Robin and Wren, to life in a memorable way that reflects the unique personality of Shannon Airport. The campaign has resonated strongly with our customers, helping to reinforce Shannon Airport’s position as the best place to fly from while delivering strong engagement across multiple channels and audiences. We’re delighted to see that work recognised through this nomination.”

Hannah Kelleher, Senior Account Director with Havas Media, said, “It is a pleasure to work with the Shannon Airport marketing team, whose vision, ambition and passion for the growth of the airport are evident in everything they do. This nomination reflects a truly collaborative effort to strengthen the Shannon Airport brand and connect with audiences across Ireland”.

The Digital Media Awards are among Ireland’s most prestigious industry accolades, recognising outstanding achievement in digital innovation, creativity and measurable impact across a wide range of categories. Each year, the awards attract hundreds of entries from leading agencies, brands and organisations of all sizes.

Winners will be announced at a gala awards ceremony on 9th October at the Radisson Blu Hotel, Dublin.
